summary: Iteration 7, tested only on the isolated QA stack (127.0.0.1:8088/order, mongod 27018). (1) Reseller auto-refresh: PASS. Polling updated the view in about 18s. Focus/visibility refetch came back in 0.3s. No polling while the tab was hidden. Page-size preferences were kept (10/5). The page was clamped correctly: with page size 10, last page 3 of 25 items became page 2 of 19, showing 11-19 and 9 items, with no blank page. The admin detail page made no polling requests in 22s. (2) Compact pager: PASS. At 1920x800 and 390x844 both reseller pagers have identical geometry: count and select on one row with the select flush right, nav centred below (offset 0), icons only, no overflow, document width 390 on mobile. Other pagers (order-items, payments, shipments, orders-table) are unchanged: 10/20/50/100 and the Sebelumnya/Berikutnya labels on desktop. (3) Rollback with fault injection: PASS. 6 fault points: order_payments, orders, shipments, resi_files (orders only, which also covers the pending-WA cancel and seq reset before the fault), users (orders+resellers) and notification_logs. Each returned 500 '...terverifikasi'. A full snapshot diff (every doc of orders/order_payments/shipments/products/resellers/users/notification_logs/announcement_states/webhook_events, order_seq, SHA-256 of resi files) was identical before and after. Pending notifications stayed pending, and order detail and photo URLs returned 200. For resi_files, ctime proved exactly the first file was really deleted and then restored. FAIL_RESTORE=1 returned 500 'TIDAK terverifikasi' with the backup folder name. History shows gagal_pemulihan_otomatis / 'Gagal, perlu pemulihan manual' in the UI. The partial deletion stayed in place (orders=0) and the backup folder kept its jsonl and 3 resi files. The manual CLI printed the verification lines and 'Pemulihan selesai dan terverifikasi.' with exit 0. Data then matched exactly, except that pending WA notifications were set to cancelled, which is by design. The CLI exits non-zero on an invalid folder. A normal cleanup after restarting without fault env succeeded. (4) Scripts: bash -n passes for both. They re-exec with sudo when not root. The README uses only 'sudo docker compose', has no usermod, and puts cron in 'sudo crontab -e'. (5) API regression: 27/27 passed (3 roles login with HttpOnly cookies, products, resellers authz, order, payment, progress, shipment with photo and reseller photo view, over-ship 422, reports, dashboards, simulated WA log, branding save/reset/validation, cleanup preview, admin2/reseller 403). UI regression: all admin pages load (dashboard, orders, products, resellers, users, reports, notifications, audit, settings cleanup history). Reseller page-size options are 5/10/20/50/100.

minor.issue: Manual CLI verification only counts that _id values are present (count_documents). It does not compare document content the way verify_restore does. Resi files are checked only for existence, not size/hash.
Resi files are copied only if missing (`if not dst.exists()`). A partially written or corrupted existing file is never overwritten. verify_restore checks only size, not a hash.

issues: Entries with 'Gagal, data dipulihkan' still say 'Terhapus: Order 2, Pembayaran 2...'. This can mislead the owner into thinking data was lost. Suggest the label 'Sempat terhapus lalu dipulihkan' for rolled-back entries.
